text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence spreads into daily life. One major problem is bias: if the data used to train a system is unfair, the AI may make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or health care. Fairness means treating all people equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI often collects personal information, and this data must be protected. Transparency matters too — people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development requires companies and governments to set clear rules. If we ignore these issues, AI could harm society instead of helping it.
